metadata.description: Developer productivity plugins for Claude Code

plugins.name: action-run
plugins.description: Trigger and monitor any GitHub Actions workflow by name, gather required inputs, and fix failures automatically.

plugins.name: action-check
plugins.description: Check the latest GitHub Actions workflow run, monitor in-progress runs to completion, and report failures with logs.

plugins.name: git-commit
plugins.description: Create a git commit with staged changes, handling pre-commit hooks automatically.
